additive_levers.attribution_limitation: a run recorded as SCHEDULED is invoked with the scheduler's own arguments, which is also what an on-demand `schtasks /run` does; the Task Scheduler operational log that would separate them is disabled on this host, so an off-phase launch is reported as off-phase and not attributed to a mechanism
additive_levers.what_start_when_available_buys: it converts a start missed while the host was unavailable into a catch-up run when the host returns; it does not help a start that could not run because no session existed, which is the loss this campaign is actually about

AUTHORISED_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.why_not_attempted: no account in this inventory is designated for the lane, and granting a right to an existing account is a change to this host's policy, which this package does not make

INDEPENDENT_HOST_RUNNER.reading: no SSH configuration, no known remote host and no self-hosted runner declaration was found in this checkout; a runner on another host stays a documented option for an operator who has one, not a mechanism this package can exercise

LOGON_TRIGGER.detail: the LogonTrigger is additive: it does not remove the session absence, it bounds the recovery from it, and it is registered in the same scheduler the lane already uses

S4U_PROPOSAL.target: the committed proposal, re-registered with LogonType=S4U
S4U_PROPOSAL.what_it_would_remove: the 24 triggers of the measured window that produced no process because no session existed: an S4U task does not need one

SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL.target: a registration whose principal is SYSTEM, which is what a service class of runner needs
SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL.what_it_would_remove: the session dependence, and the need for a signed-in user at all

WINDOWS_SERVICE.operator_command: an administrator installs the runner as a service, or registers the task with LogonType=S4U, which removes the same dependence with a smaller change
WINDOWS_SERVICE.what_it_would_remove: the session dependence, and with it the need for any account to be signed in; it is the same effect as an S4U task at a larger price
WINDOWS_SERVICE.why_not_attempted: creating a service needs administrator rights; a refused attempt can leave a half-created service behind, and this package does not change the host

WITNESS_ACTION.turns_silence_into: a witness line proves the scheduler started the task; its absence proves the trigger never produced a process, which is the distinction the Task Scheduler's disabled operational log cannot make on this host
